build_RFP_neck: build a Recursive Feature Pyramid neck module with configurable RFP steps and backbone for DetectoRS object detection
create_ASPP_module: create an Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling module with configurable dilation rates for multi-scale feature extraction
run_RFP_forward: run the RFP forward pass with multi-level features and input image through recursive feature pyramid steps
run_ASPP_forward: run the ASPP forward pass to apply atrous convolutions with multiple dilation rates on input features
init_RFP_weights: initialize RFP neck weights using Xavier initialization for conv layers and constant zero init for fusion weights
